text:
aisha: Postmortem follow-up: vendor outage chain (cloud region flake -> registry read spikes -> auth refresh storms). Need clear owners, short-term hotfixes, and tickets with rollback criteria. Reply with ownership or :wave:.

incidents-bot: PM doc: https://redwood.internal/pm/vendor-chain-2026-03-22. Runbooks: /runbooks/cloud-failover, /runbooks/registry-fallback, /runbooks/oidc-degrade.

ben: I'll own cloud failover automations. Short-term: tighten health checks + app-layer reroute toggle. ETA: 2026-04-08. Will add smoke tests.

carlos: I'll take registry mitigations: client retries + circuit breaker + regional manifest replication. ETA: 2026-04-10. Will include checksum diff test.

lucy: Serving fallback: cached-manifest mode if registry unreachable >30s. I'll implement tests to detect model mismatch. ETA: 2026-04-04.

marco: Auth hotfix: per-process refresh mutex + jittered backoff. Can ship in 48h. Longer-term: shared refresh service. Hotfix ETA: 2026-03-28, design ETA: 2026-04-20.

kevin: Ops will add partial-region alarms and schedule monthly cross-region failover drills. I'll create runbook test ticket. ETA: 2026-04-02.

aisha: Draft AIs (confirm owners):
- AI-7011: App-layer failover + smoke tests (owner: ben) ETA: 2026-04-08
- AI-7012: Registry retries + replication (owner: carlos) ETA: 2026-04-10
- AI-7013: Cached-manifest serving + harness (owner: lucy) ETA: 2026-04-04
- AI-7014: Auth hotfix + canary (owner: marco) ETA: 2026-03-28
- AI-7015: Region alarms + monthly drill (owner: kevin) ETA: 2026-04-02

incidents-bot: Tickets created: AI-7011, AI-7012, AI-7013, AI-7014, AI-7015. Linked to PM-2026-03-22.

ben: Agree app-layer first; add DNS-switch fallback gated by N-minute failure. Will document rollback criteria (increase in 5xx or session loss >0.5%).

carlos: Will include client circuit breaker to avoid stampeding the registry during auth storms.

lucy: I'll add an eval to compare cached vs live manifests on canary traffic. Fail if checksum mismatch >0.2%.

marco: Shipping hotfix tonight. Ben/kevin please canary and monitor 401 rate + 5xxs.

kevin: Will canary and post metrics to AI-7014. Ops will tag dashboards.

aisha: Thanks. Please update your AI ticket with test steps, rollback criteria, and alert links within 24h. Follow-up review 2026-04-06 09:00 PT. Closing thread here but keep updates on the tickets.
